submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured, index 24 (Bi0.29 Fe0.18 V0.53) had the highest photocurrent, 26.7 µA. It sits on the V-rich, low-Fe side of the BiVO4-like region. Photocurrent rose about 3.8x going from the near-stoichiometric Bi≈V point to this one, then dropped at the more V-rich point, so the optimum is probably at moderate V excess near index 24.

rejected.reason: Measured 7.06 µA. Near Bi:V=1:1 with minimal Fe, it was well below the V-rich composition.
Measured 18.3 µA. Adding more V and cutting Bi further reduced photocurrent compared with index 24.
